description: Implementation of the RecipeRepository interface providing methods to access and manipulate recipe data, including mock dataset creation, recipe search, filtering by category, and favorites management.

classes.name: RecipeRepositoryImpl
classes.description: A class that implements recipe data fetching and manipulation, using mock data and integrating with FavoritesStore.

methods.name: getAllRecipes
methods.description: Returns a flow emitting a list of all mock recipes.

methods.name: searchRecipes
methods.description: Filters recipes based on a search query and returns matching recipes as a flow.

methods.name: getRecipesByCategory
methods.description: Filters recipes by specified category and returns as a flow.

methods.name: getRecipeById
methods.description: Fetches a single recipe by ID, if exists.

methods.name: getFavorites
methods.description: Returns a flow emitting favorite recipes based on stored favorite IDs.

methods.name: isFavorite
methods.description: Checks if a recipe ID is marked as favorite.

methods.name: toggleFavorite
methods.description: Toggles the favorite status of a given recipe.
